name: Microsoft 365
summary: Microsoft's home for Word, Excel, Outlook and other apps.

flows.title: Add a user in the admin center
steps: Open the Microsoft 365 admin center. In Dashboard view, go to Users > Active users and select Add a user; in Simplified view, select Add user.
Fill in the basics: first name, family name, display name and username, and choose the domain for the user's account. Select Next.
Select the location and the product license for the user. Expand Roles to make them an admin, or Profile info to add more about them.
Review the new user's settings and select Finish adding.

flows.title: Create a Microsoft 365 group
steps: In the Microsoft 365 admin center, expand Teams & groups and select Active teams & groups.
Select Add Microsoft 365 group. On the Basics page, type a name and an optional description, and select Next.
On the Owners page, choose the people who manage the group; on the Members page, choose its members. Select Next after each.
On the Settings page, type a unique email address for the group, choose a privacy option and whether to add Microsoft Teams, and select Next.
Review the settings, select Create group, then select Close.

flows.title: Add members to a group
steps: In the Microsoft 365 admin center, go to Active teams & groups and select the group's name.
On the Membership tab, select Members.
Select Add members, select the users, and select Save.
Select Close three times. The group appears in Outlook with those members.
